---
title: ARR2
---

# Description

The ARR2 prior [@kohnsARR2PriorFlexible2024a] is a global-local shrinkage prior for autoregressive models. It adapts the R2-D2 prior [@zhangBayesianRegressionUsing2022a] to the time-series setting by placing a joint prior on the autoregressive coefficients and their induced $R^2$. Compared to other priors for time-series models, the ARR2 prior allows for flexible and interpretable shrinkage: the user can encode prior beliefs about the overall explanatory power of the lagged outcomes (via $R^2$) and about the relative importance of each lag (via the simplex proportions $\psi$).

# Definition

For an AR($p$) model:

$$
\begin{align}
y_t &\sim \text{normal}(\mu_t, \sigma^2), \quad t = p+1, \dotsc, T \\
\mu_t &= \sum_{i=1}^{p} \phi_i \, y_{t-i}
\end{align}
$$

the ARR2 prior is:

$$
\begin{align}
\phi_i &\sim \text{normal}\!\left(0,\; \frac{\sigma^2}{\sigma_y^2}\,\tau^2\,\psi_i\right) \\[6pt]
\tau^2 &= \frac{R^2}{1 - R^2} \\[6pt]
R^2 &\sim \text{beta}(\mu_{R^2},\, \varphi_{R^2}) \\[6pt]
\psi &\sim \text{Dirichlet}(\xi_1, \dotsc, \xi_p) \\[6pt]
\sigma &\sim p(\sigma)
\end{align}
$$

where $\sigma_y^2$ is the (unconditional) sample variance of $y$.

The signal-to-noise ratio $\tau^2 = R^2/(1-R^2)$ reparameterizes the prior in terms of $R^2$, the proportion of variance in $y$ explained by the autoregressive component. The proportions $\psi_i$ lie on the simplex ($\psi_i \geq 0$, $\sum_i \psi_i = 1$) and determine how the total prior variance $\tau^2$ is allocated among the $p$ lag coefficients. A symmetric Dirichlet concentration $\xi_i = a_\pi$ with $a_\pi \leq 1/2$ favours sparsity, concentrating the explanatory power on a few lags.

The scaling by $\sigma^2 / \sigma_y^2$ ensures that the prior on the AR coefficients is invariant to the units of $y$: the coefficients $\phi_i$ are dimensionless (they relate $y_t$ to past values of $y$ in the same units), and the factor $\sigma_y^2$ normalizes the prior variance relative to the unconditional variability of the series.

# Things to specify

Prior on $\sigma$. Hyperparameters $\mu_{R^2}$ and $\varphi_{R^2}$ (mean and precision of the $R^2$ prior), and $\xi_1, \dotsc, \xi_p$ (Dirichlet concentration parameters for the lag-coefficient proportions).
